records.part: FDA approved assay kits compatible with the Cepheid GeneXpert system for detection of Mycobacterium Tuberculosis complex DNA and Rifampin resistance
records.reason: The Cepheid Cat. No. GMTB/RIF-US-10 Xpert Assay kits are the only FDA approved kits compatible with the Cepheid GeneXpert system and test algorithm used by the BPHL Tuberculosis section.
